steps.query: Looked for a product selected for Medicare price negotiation.

candidate.text: Biktarvy's Medicare price is set by negotiation from January 2028: CMS Part B+D spend $3,904.5M; assumed base list discount 65.5% (median of the cycle 1-2 negotiated discounts in the CMS fact sheets; cited range 38% to 85%; no same-class MFP published). US generic entry no earlier than April 1, 2036 under the patent settlements (10-K), not the earlier 2033 projection, so the set price runs eight years before generics. Bear precedent for the first set-price year: Amgen's ENBREL net selling price fell 22% under Part D price setting; bull precedent: BMS cut the Eliquis list price and Eliquis revenue rose 22% in its first set-price year.

steps.verdict_reason: passed the citation and numeric gates; one of the five shown; the Sharpest Needle
